plot: On a snowy evening Grumpy babysits Bertha's toddler cousin Tot at his tow yard while Bertha drives the school choir over the hill (she says she blinks her lights three times if she needs help, planted early); Grumpy's rules and a bedtime 'Tow Truck Manual' story fail, Tot copies his 'hmph', Bolt and Turbo on patrol warn the hill road is slippery and Bolt says 'look where the witness looks'; Tot keeps beeping 'Blinky! Big Yellow!' at the hill and Grumpy thinks he just misses Bertha, until he goes down to Tot's height and sees three blinks: Bertha's bus is stuck in a ditch; Grumpy takes Tot on his first real tow and pulls her out; lesson: even the smallest voice can say the biggest thing; cliffhanger: Pip's grandma visits tomorrow and wants to meet Grumpy.

script.title: Grumpy Babysits on a Snowy Night?!
script.description: Grumpy has rules. Tot has a beep. And Bertha is out on the snowy hill. Inspector Bolt #28

set.place: Grumpy's tow yard at the edge of Wheelburg and the snowy hill road above it, a snowy evening until late night

beats.say: Beep beep beep! Vroom vroom! Again! Again!
Bertha. You said he sleeps. He does not sleep.
It was a snowy evening at Grumpy's tow yard.
He'll sleep, sweetie. Just keep him happy and warm.
I'm driving the school choir over the hill to the Winter Concert.
Back at nine. And remember, if I ever need help...
I blink my big lights. Three times. Blink, blink, blink!
Nobody needs help. Go. Sing. Come back.
Bye-bye, Big Yellow! Bye-bye!
Bertha drove off into the snow. Now it was just the two of them.
Rule number one. In my yard, we are quiet.
BEEEP!
Rule number two. We do not zoom.
Zoom zoom zoom! Round the tyres!
Rule number three. Rules are not a game.
Tot zoomed past the old tyres, the crane and the junk pile.
Grumpy funny! Grumpy big and grey!
I am not funny. I am a professional.
Grumpy had one idea. A bedtime story.
The Tow Truck Manual. Page one. Chapter one. Hooks.
A hook is a hook. It hooks. The end.
Again! Again! Hook hook hook!
That was the best part. There is no again.
Hmph.
Hmph!
Don't copy me. That's my hmph.
My hmph! Hmph, hmph, hmph!
For one tiny second, Grumpy almost smiled. Almost.
Then two cars came through the snow. Bolt and Turbo, on night patrol.
Good evening, Grumpy. We heard rather a lot of beeping.
We closed the hill road with a cone. It's super slippery!
Even I drove slowly! Well... slowly for me.
Do you need any help with the little one?
No. I have rules. And a manual.
Very well. Remember: a good inspector looks where the witness looks.
I'm not an inspector. And he's not a witness. He's a beeper.
Bolt and Turbo drove on. And Tot rolled to the fence.
Blinky! Blinky! Big Yellow! Big Yellow!
Big Yellow is at the concert. She comes back at nine.
If you're still awake at nine, Bertha won't trust me again.
No sleep! Blinky! Blinky!
Blinky. Is that your toy? Your blanket? Your ball?
No ball! BLINKY!
Tot honked louder. And louder. Right at the dark hill.
Little ones miss their family. That's all it is.
You miss Big Yellow. I get it. She'll be back soon.
Big Yellow BLINKY!
Grumpy sighed. Then he remembered what Bolt had said.
Look where the witness looks. Fine. Just this once.
Grumpy rolled to the fence. And went down low, low, low. To Tot's size.
Hmph. From down here, I can see... the hill road.
Far away, on the dark hill, a yellow light blinked.
Blink. Blink. Blink.
Three times. 'If I need help, I blink three times.'
Tot wasn't fussing. He was telling me. All along!
Blinky! Big Yellow stuck!
Bertha's stuck in the snow. With thirty kids.
Grumpy looked at the hill. Then at Tot. He couldn't leave Tot alone.
Tot. Want to see a real tow? Stay close to me.
Real tow! Real tow! Yay!
Slowly, carefully, past Turbo's cone and up the slippery hill road.
There was Big Bertha, two wheels deep in a snowy ditch.
Grumpy! Oh, Grumpy! How did you see my blinks?
I didn't. Tot did. I only listened. Finally.
My little Tot! You saw me from all the way down there?
Tot see! Tot tell! Grumpy slow!
Inside the bus, thirty kids were warm, singing a winter song.
Hook on. Nice and gentle. One... two... pull.
Creak. Crunch. Pop! Big Bertha rolled out of the ditch.
You did it! The kids will be home in time for bed!
Again! Again!
No again. Once is plenty.
Back at the yard, Tot finally closed his eyes.
He sleeps. Rule number four. Little ones see things too.
Thank you, Grumpy. You were the best babysitter tonight.
Don't tell anyone. I have a grumpy name to keep.
Too late, old friend. Turbo has already told the whole town.
Even the smallest voice can say the biggest thing.
Hmph... zzz...
The next morning, Pip zoomed into the yard with big news.
My grandma is coming to visit tomorrow! For the very first time!
And she wants to meet ALL my friends. Even you, Grumpy!
Me? Meet a grandma? What do I say to a grandma?
What do you think Bolt will find next time? We'll find out in the next episode!
